source: art/blender/train_sotr.py (seed 50); brief docs/design/UpcomingFilm_Brief.md section 4; owner spec section 9 (docs/design/owner/TributeSpec_BloodAndMovement_2026-11-14.md)
axes: Roblox (x, y, z) = Blender (x, z, -y); an asset's front (+Y in Blender) is its Roblox LookVector (-Z). Each GLB lays its assets in a row along X: set Model.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(origin), then PivotTo the layout CFrame (and undo the importer's 180-degree turn about Y as ItemAssets does).

patterns.1: upholstery: cream C-arcs (openings alternating by row) and dots on burgundy, 1.4-stud cells
patterns.2: carpet: gold diagonal lattice with cream lozenges, 2-stud cells
patterns.3: table runner: gold chevrons on burgundy, 1.2-stud cells

layout.hall: Blender hall space: x across (west -85 .. east +85), y along (entrance +210 .. far end -210), floor 0 -> Roblox (x, y, z) = (x, z, -y): the entrance end is Roblox -Z. Positions below are Roblox, relative to the hall origin (the hall's floor centre); yawDeg about +Y.

lighting.station: Lighting.Ambient (70, 56, 44), ColorShift_Top (200, 140, 90), a warm low sun through the west glazing; SurfaceLights facing in on every ShedBay/EntranceWalls/ShedEnd Glow part (Color (248, 232, 222), Brightness 1.5, Range 40); warm downlights in the coffers; the nose lamps' red PointLights.
lighting.train: Amber cove SurfaceLights on the Cove parts (255, 196, 128), the chandeliers' and pendants' PointLights (swing with them), the lounge screen's cool SurfaceLight (the only cool light), guard-car strip lights; the windows glow amber from outside at night (Roblox does this from the interior lights).
lighting.night journey: Moonlit blue outside (Ambient ~ (40, 48, 70)), amber windows inside; Train_BridgeBackdrop with its DeckLights.

motion.sway: constant 1.5 degree roll and a 0.4-stud vertical float on a slow sine (period ~6 s), out of phase front to back (spec section 9); move each car model as a whole (shell + interior + pieces welded to its root).
motion.pieces: Train_Chandelier / Train_PendantLamp swing on their hang points; Train_BudVase and Train_Crystal slide a little with the sway; Station_Banner sways in the station.
motion.doors: Train_DoorLeaf: plug door (0.2 in, then 4.2 along); Train_VestibuleDoor 4.3 along +X (pneumatic thump); Train_CompartmentDoor 4.2 along +Y; Train_GangwayDoor 4.2 along +X.
motion.sound: 52 Hz hum, glass chime, cutlery shift, door thump, piano pedal squeak, boots on steel (spec).

collision: Every mesh part is visual (CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch off, CollisionFidelity Box). Build the collision from each asset's 'colliders' (invisible anchored Parts: centre and size in Roblox space relative to the asset pivot; tag 'Floor' marks walkable tops). Doors leave 4 x 7.5 gaps.
import: Import each GLB (3D Importer or bulk import); each asset root arrives as a Model of MeshParts <Asset>_<Role>[_n]. Re-centre with 'origin' (art/README.md section 4).

Per part: textured parts get ONE SurfaceAppearance from 'surfaceAppearance' (ColorMap, NormalMap, RoughnessMap, MetalnessMap where given; Color white); Neon parts: Material Neon, Color = rgb, no SurfaceAppearance; Glass parts: Material Glass, Color = rgb, Transparency from the part.
Every mesh part: Anchored (cars are anchored and moved as a whole by script), CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch off, CastShadow per part; then add the colliders.

Attachments: create under the asset's first part with WorldCFrame = pivot * CFrame.lookAt(position, position + look, up). Door, chandelier, lamp, lid, vase, glass and guard attachments say which separate model goes there.
Assemble the station and both trains from 'layout' (Roblox positions relative to the hall origin).
No upload has been made; uploads need the owner's go-ahead.
styleRules: Style A, faceted realism (docs/design/ArtStyle.md): true scale (1 stud = 0.28 m, player 5.5, doors 4 x 7.5), real members as chamfered prisms, flat-shaded facets (1-2.5 studs on architecture and car bodies, 0.3-1 on props), nothing modelled under ~0.25 stud except trim.

Painted, not textured: one flat value per facet (+-5% per volume, +-2.5% per facet, lighter and warmer on top, cooler underneath), two-radius AO multiplied in (never below half the painted value), a 0.015-0.1-stud bevel normal; our own patterns (upholstery arcs, carpet lattice, runner) baked at 1.2-2-stud cells.

Semi-real tones from UpcomingFilm_Brief.md 4.6 (sampled from the film, softened, clamped into the light band); matte except real metal, glass, the polished platform stone (0.4) and the train's semi-gloss lacquer (0.3).
Darkness inside comes from the light rigs listed in 'lighting', never from the paint; saturated colour only on signals (the red-orange nose lamp, amber board rows, the cool propaganda screen).
No film lettering, emblems, posters, slogans, seals or crests anywhere: every sign, emblem, poster, board row and plate motif is our own; the boards carry abstract glyph blocks, not words.
ip: Film-faithful places by the owner's choice; no film imagery, lettering, logos, emblems, posters, seals or crests. In-game names stay an open decision (the plaques and boards are blank or abstract).

assets.name: Station_Coffer
assets.notes: One 12 x 12 coffer of the entrance hall's concrete ceiling (1-stud chamfered rib soffit, a sloped recess 4 deep, a round downlight), tiled 160 times round the oval (layout). Out of reach: no collision.
assets.pivot: on the floor under the cell centre (the soffit is 40 up)

Downlight.note: warm SpotLight (255, 214, 170), Brightness 1, Range 40, Angle 70, or a SurfaceLight on the disc

assets.name: Station_EntranceCeiling
assets.notes: The unique part of the entrance hall's coffered ceiling: the soffit collar round the 100 x 50 oval with 28 radial ribs, the deep fascia ring that rises to the lantern, the perimeter strips and the header wall over the shed's mouth. The regular coffers are Station_Coffer modules (layout). Origin = the oval's centre on the floor. Out of reach: no collision.

assets.name: Station_Lantern
assets.notes: Elliptical drum (z 44-72) and coffered dome above the oval: 24 pilasters, 24 radial ribs, a ring rib and a hub the sculpture hangs from. Origin = the oval's centre on the floor.

assets.name: Station_Sunburst
assets.notes: Our own sculpture in the film's spirit: 10 long tapered gold blades in two fans of five, gathered by two collars at the centre and rising to the drum's rim (40-52 studs long, 6-sided sections, a slight sag and twist), with a faceted gold drop between the collars. Hung from the lantern by steel rods. Brushed gold: metalness 0.9, roughness 0.3. Origin = the oval's centre on the floor.

assets.name: Station_EntranceWalls
assets.notes: The entrance hall's side walls (columns, a stone base with service doors, tall bronze-framed glazing glowing amber from behind) and the end wall (three glass doorways, clerestory). Origin = the oval's centre on the floor. Collision: use the colliders (mesh parts are visual).

assets.name: Station_EntranceFloor
assets.notes: Polished stone floor of the entrance hall (6-stud slabs, roughness 0.4) with our own brass 'sunrise' inlay at the shed's mouth; the guideway pits' end walls and buffer stops. Origin = the oval's centre on the floor.

assets.name: Station_Portal
assets.notes: The white cross-beam (6 high) at the shed's mouth on four columns, carrying our own gold emblem (a rayed disc and bars; no lettering). Origin = floor centre at the shed's mouth (hall y 126).

assets.name: Station_ShedBay
assets.notes: One 24-stud slice of the train shed, repeated 14 times (+4 as backdrop): glazed walls 60 high with white mullions every 6 studs and stepped fins (deep low, shallow high), transoms, the amber-pink glow behind the glass (emissive backdrop: add warm SurfaceLights facing in), the roof's white beams every 6 studs and purlins under roof glazing. Origin = the slice's floor centre.

assets.name: Station_FloorBay
assets.notes: One 24-stud slice of floor: the concourse (66) and two platforms (30) in polished stone slabs, a muted edge band and nosing, the guideway pits (22, floor at -5) with the maglev T-beam and its guide rails under each track (no sleepers, no rails to ride on). Origin = the slice's floor centre.

assets.name: Station_ShedEnd
assets.notes: The far end of the shed, open to the light: a white portal frame, a glazed upper band with fins, a pale apron and the glow beyond; the pits and maglev beams run 180 studs out under the parked trains. Origin = floor centre at the end (hall y -354).

assets.name: Station_Banner
assets.notes: Narrow maroon-brown banner (5 x 18) with a pointed bottom, hanging from a brass rod; our own gold motif on both faces (a border, a rising half-sun with rays, a bar and a chevron), never the film's arrow and roundel. Sways as one piece (separate mesh); the Cable part stretches to the beam above.
assets.pivot: the rod's centre (hang point); the cable runs 24 up

Hang.note: top of the cable: weld to the roof beam above

assets.name: Station_Board
assets.notes: Departure board 10 x 5 on two posts (board z 11-16), with rows of our own abstract glyph blocks in white and amber on both faces (no words, no film text). Glyphs are Neon parts.

Light.note: optional SurfaceLight on the Glyphs (white), Brightness 0.3, Range 6

assets.name: Station_Poster
assets.notes: Framed propaganda poster 14 x 24 with our own art: a heroic faceted guard (white armour, black harness, our own gold chest emblem) against a maroon sunburst, a slate band with blank cream bars (no slogan, no film character). Hangs on a wall: origin = bottom centre of the frame's back, front +Y.

assets.name: Station_Guard
assets.notes: Our own guard in white armour (helmet, cuirass, pauldrons, greaves, bracers), black harness, black visor and boots, with our own small gold chest emblem; 5.6 tall at attention. A static statue mesh for the rows on the platforms and in the guard car (rig it later if guards must move). Origin = between the feet, facing +Y.

assets.name: Train_NoseCar
assets.notes: Nose car (car 1; car 7 is the same car turned round as the tail), 90 long, 11.5 wide, 13.2 tall over a maglev guideway (no wheels). Glossy black lacquer with a maroon flank between gold pinstripes (semi-gloss: roughness 0.3, metalness 0.2, brief 4.3), round-cornered brass windows, plug doors 4 x 7.5 (Train_DoorLeaf, separate), gangway diaphragms. Origin = footprint centre at platform level; the interior floor is 0.3 up; front +Y (Roblox -Z). Interior kits fit inside (same origin).
